FIFA 20 TEAM OF THE WEEK

The FIFA 20 TOTW is released every Wednesday and it features players that have played well the previous week in real life.
These cards are released as ‘In Form’ for that week only and have boosted stats and altered card art.

FIFA 20 TOTW (TEAM OF THE WEEK)

In this page, you can check our predictions and the official FIFA 20 TOTW squads.
Active or finished weeks are highlighted on green.
All release times are indicated in the UK time zone.
